name: Sphinxie · Gremlet #49
description:
A sphinx kitten in a royal headdress. Asks riddles, forgets the answers.

One of 50 one-of-a-kind Gremlets. Owning this token unlocks Sphinxie in the Gremlets desktop app, where it walks on your windows, naps, plays with other Gremlets and shows off its signature move.
